title: Light Working Through; Two Faces; the Cosmic Body Within
description: How the conjunction works in the soul day by day. T79 — light comes in and works through the soul: she carries the whole archonic host within her, and the daily reception of nourishment habitually purifies, cleanses, filters, washes forth the mingling of darkness mingled into her. T80 — two faces shown forth in the rational: the face of love (beauty with longing) and the face of love-of-strife being refined; both visible at once because the soul is twofold, not yet sorted but already showing what it is becoming and what it is laying off. T81 — how precious truths are formed in the natural mind like pearls in a fitted vessel; and how the soul wearing a body is settled by what comes into her in the proper order, or disturbed when bitter food enters.
